key_concepts: Science helps explain how the natural world works.
Observing is a science skill that uses the senses.
The five senses are sight, hearing, touch, smell, and taste.
Skin is used for touching and feeling.
Objects in the surroundings can be described using the senses.
Activities in the community can be described using the senses.
Natural events are happenings caused by nature, not by humans.
